title: Servicing Desk Training Note — Insured Growing Crop Values Counted on Operating Lines of Credit Certificates
content:
**What insured growing crop value counts on an Operating Lines of Credit borrowing base certificate?**

The value counted for insured growing crops depends on the line's crop-year assigned policy — a Crop Insurance policy in active status for the line's crop year whose indemnity is assigned to the association for this line — and on whether that policy's harvest price has been released.

## Rule

The insured growing crops value counted is:

- the **lower of the stated value and the policy guarantee figured at the higher of the projected price and the harvest price**, when the crop-year assigned policy's harvest price has been released;
- the **lower of the stated value and the policy guarantee figured at the projected price**, when that policy's harvest price has not yet been released;
- the **stated value** as written on the certificate, when the line has no crop-year assigned policy.

The policy guarantee is the approved yield multiplied by the insured acres, multiplied by the coverage level read as a percentage, multiplied by the price named. The figures are those of the crop-year assigned policy on the Crop Insurance records: its approved yield, insured acres, coverage level, projected price and, once released, harvest price.

## Worked case (hypothetical policy and certificate)

The crop-year assigned policy shows an approved yield of 180, 500 insured acres and a 75% coverage level, with a projected price of USD 4.60. The certificate states USD 340,000 of insured growing crops.

| Harvest price on the policy | Price named | Policy guarantee | Value counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Not yet released | USD 4.60 (projected) | 180 multiplied by 500, by 75% and by USD 4.60, that is USD 310,500 | USD 310,500 — lower than the stated USD 340,000 |
| Released at USD 4.20 | USD 4.60 (the higher of the two) | USD 310,500 | USD 310,500 |
| Released at USD 4.90 | USD 4.90 (the higher of the two) | USD 330,750 | USD 330,750 |
| Released at USD 5.40 | USD 5.40 | USD 364,500 | USD 340,000 — the stated value is lower |

Without a crop-year assigned policy, the stated USD 340,000 is the value counted.

## Further questions

**Does a policy active for the crop year but assigned to a different loan set the guarantee?** No. Only a policy whose indemnity is assigned to the association for this line is the crop-year assigned policy; without one the stated value is counted.

**Can the value counted exceed the stated value?** No. Where a guarantee is figured, the lower of the two is counted.
